representation_fit.evidence: Primary object = metric, matching brief object_type; 1280x860/1440x900 viewports show 28 live metric tiles in 4 domain groups with value, unit, ±%/1min delta, threshold-banded sparkline and status word — high temporality/density/many shape facets addressed; event stream + alert bar cover the volatile stream (app.js:35-63, index.html:33-40).

primary_task_salience.evidence: Monitor task owns the initial screen in both viewports: alert ticker with active anomalies at top (结账错误率 5.16% 严重·01:22, index.html:33), full-bleed metric grid, right rail event stream (1280x860.png, 1440x900.png); status counts 29/2/1 pills in topbar (index.html:20-24).

time_to_understand.evidence: Self-describing title 指标流监视台 (index.html:13), status legend 正常/警告/严重 (index.html:64-66), per-tile status words plus 持续 duration, and footer note explaining hysteresis behavior (index.html:67) — semantics readable at a glance in both screenshots.

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object is on the initial screen; one click on a tile selects and opens the trace panel (app.js:185, app.js:369-377), feed rows and alert chips are also one click (app.js:332, app.js:359-363), domain filter chips + 仅看异常 narrow the set (app.js:427-439, app.js:481-486), and ?select=<id> deep link jumps straight to a metric (app.js:499-500).

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions are in-place: selection renders into the rail detail panel while the grid stays visible (index.html:42-59), no routes/modals; filter, pause and speed state persist on the page (app.js:153, app.js:470-486); status history kept per metric (m.trace, app.js:98-106).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces = topbar (counts, 5 filter chips, 仅看异常/速度/暂停), alert bar, grouped grid, rail (feed + trace), footer legend (index.html:10-68). Every surface serves the monitoring job required by the high-density brief; no decorative or idle panels visible in either viewport.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.contrast fail, a11y.focus_order fail, a11y.target_size pass (measurement-summary.json). Source corroborates risk: low-contrast tokens --dim:#8b98a9/--faint:#5a6675 on dark panels (styles.css:5) and no :focus-visible rules anywhere in styles.css. Mitigations present: tiles/buttons with aria-label (app.js:169), aria-pressed toggle (app.js:484), status never color-only (text words, app.js:292-294), prefers-reduced-motion honored (styles.css:207-210).

frontend_rework.evidence: Both screenshots render cleanly and text.truncation + layout.responsive_collision pass, but 4 of 7 checks fail: layout.overflow, a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json) — implying real rework even though overflow is not visually manifest (candidates: nowrap topbar styles.css:29, fixed 356px rail styles.css:90, long footer note index.html:67). Minor code defect: duplicated dead font assignment app.js:233-234.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 指标变化可追溯，无闪烁噪声 explicitly engineered: hysteresis state machine 2-sample trigger/3-sample recover (app.js:111-124, index.html:67), stable grid order built once and updated in place with cached strings (app.js:157-188, app.js:276-301), tabular-nums (styles.css:19), one-shot non-looping ping (styles.css:136-146); traceability via global event stream (app.js:346-363), per-metric 状态变化史 (app.js:408-414), event markers on the detail curve (app.js:241-252), and deep link (app.js:499-500). Screenshots show sustained durations (严重 持续 01:22, 警告 持续 00:44), not flicker; first-screen ready via 240 synchronously seeded samples (app.js:138-145) satisfying the usable-at-load constraint.

defects_observed: a11y.contrast: fail (measurement-summary.json) — consistent with --faint/--dim text tokens on dark panels (styles.css:5, styles.css:24)
a11y.focus_order: fail (measurement-summary.json) — no :focus-visible styling defined in styles.css
type.min_projected_size: fail (measurement-summary.json) — 11px UI text (styles.css:24, styles.css:128, styles.css:195) and 9px canvas threshold labels (app.js:234)

layout.overflow: fail (measurement-summary.json) — not visually manifest in either screenshot; likely nowrap topbar (styles.css:29), fixed 356px rail (styles.css:90) or long footer note (index.html:67)
Sim-clock fidelity: tick interval is 1500ms at labeled 实时流 1× while SAMPLE_MS=2000 advances simulated time, so 1× runs faster than wall clock (app.js:468 vs app.js:77, index.html:17)
scores.overall_note: This package is a strongly brief-fitted streaming monitor console: 28 metric tiles across 4 domains with threshold-banded sparklines, a top alert ticker, a clickable event stream and a per-metric trace panel with chart markers, state-change history and a deep link — directly answering the monitor×volatile-evidence-stream shape and the acceptance seed (traceable changes, no flicker via 2-trigger/3-recover hysteresis, stable grid order, in-place updates, per app.js:111-124 and index.html:67). First paint is fully usable with 240 synchronously seeded samples and pre-seeded incidents already in 严重/警告 states (app.js:66-74, app.js:138-145; visible in both viewports). The weaknesses are concentrated in accessibility and small type: the receipt records a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, type.min_projected_size and layout.overflow as failed while target_size, truncation and responsive-collision pass (measurement-summary.json); the contrast and focus failures are corroborated by low-contrast text tokens and the absence of any :focus-visible styling, and the overflow failure cannot be localized from the stills since both screenshots render cleanly. Model-judged time-to-understand is high and structural navigation/context costs are minimal (one click to any metric's trace, in-place selection), but per protocol these are structural proxies, not human measurements.
